items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Now Tom Albert was another man, one of the old men's in the Eureka band, one of the Eureka bands we started up to.

ctx.x: Maybe Eddie Vincent, the real old time trombonist, that was before your time too, was it Frog? I guess he played with Keppard and people like that. I guess so, Bill, I don't know. Yeah, he left here long before you were born.
Now Tom Albert was another man, one of the old men's in the Eureka band, one of the Eureka bands we started up to. Yeah, he was.
A lot of guys from Deerrange and Magnolia.
